scripts.build: tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && prisma generate && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.db:setup: prisma generate && tsx scripts/ensure-database-file.ts && prisma migrate deploy && tsx apps/api/src/seed.ts
scripts.dev: tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && prisma generate && tsx scripts/ensure-database-file.ts && prisma migrate deploy && tsx apps/api/src/seed.ts && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web -c cyan,blue "tsx watch apps/api/src/server.ts" "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173"
scripts.test: tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && prisma generate && vitest run apps/api/tests
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && prisma generate && tsc -b --pretty false && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
